data.description: Literal artifact data shared by every flow as $.data. These values are never interpreted as expressions.

output.description: Prism mapping of final output. Use $ref to read completed step results at $.steps.<id>.value, never $.<id>. Flow input remains at $.input. $var reads only a lexical binding name created by as/let; it cannot read a root path. Record-mode iterations may contain failed items.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Each outcome is available under steps by id.

operation.description: Name of a host-supplied operation. No implicit capabilities.

call.description: Call one operation or one exact bundled flow revision.

id.description: Failure name, either a literal string or a Prism object expression compiled during preparation and evaluated only on failure. Must return a nonempty string.

test.description: Exact boolean over the raw call result in value, before output mapping.

items.description: Array to iterate in source order.

onFailure.description: Stop the flow on an ordinary failure, or record item outcomes and continue.

id.description: Unique step name within its flow; available under steps.

input.description: Prism mapping of the call input.

output.description: Prism mapping after success. Use $ref for root paths: raw result $.value, flow input $.input and prior results $.steps.<id>.value. $var is only a lexical binding created by as/let.

when.description: Optional exact boolean, evaluated per invocation, including each item.
